blind.description: A straight interior wall segment featuring decorative rich reddish-brown wood wainscoting/panelling with six raised rectangular inset panels across two horizontal rows on the front lower half. Above the wood panelling is a smooth beige/plaster wall crowned with a projecting classic cornice moulding along the top front edge. The reverse side is a plain, flat beige/tan wall surface. Surfaces are solid, manifold, and continuous with no hovering elements or unpainted patches.
blind.from_above: A narrow, rectangular block of light tan/beige showing the flat top of the wall section and slight projection of the top moulding.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1.2 times taller than the figure (roughly 7 feet tall) and roughly 4 to 5 feet wide.
